premises: Alumina coatings can serve as effective anti-oxidation barriers for refractory high-entropy alloys.
A thin, adherent alumina coating can be deposited on HfNbTaTiZr without degrading its mechanical properties.
The coating will remain intact and adherent under 1000 °C air exposure and mechanical loading at 10⁻⁴–10⁻² s⁻¹.
Preventing oxygen ingress will preserve the alloy's room-temperature ductility and high-temperature yield strength.
